status: Editorial analysis of the published 138-scene chapter; no story or art changes

source.stableIdMappingSource: R16 story-plan.json (days and IDs only; no old draft status or scores copied)

method.axis: Current published story-scene positions, not seconds; cover excluded.
method.annotation: Manual primary-beat and ordinal editorial ratings after reading all English and Russian captions sequentially. Thirty actual published image anchors inspected on a contact sheet. Other visual claims are intentionally absent.
method.uncertainty: Interpretive low/medium/high editorial categories, not psychological measurements, predicted laughs, quality scores, frame timing or a Disney/Pixar ground truth. Same three-level metric family as R8; prefer broad blocks and raw steps, not a statistically smoothed curve.
method.aggregation: For sequence summaries, use the modal category (or explicitly labeled median ordinal category); do not present sums, averages or differences as measured quantities.
method.comparison: Prior R8 chart described126 scenes, six days and twelve planned outcomes with activity/pressure/attention on three levels. This publication has138 scenes, four days and six. The same category family is retained, but the new annotations are re-read from current captions; old target curves are not imported. Warmth is a categorical band.
method.wordCount: Whitespace-delimited tokens in narrative paragraphs only.

rubric.activity: Editorial action emphasis: low looking/listening/rest; medium deliberate gestures, travel or practical work; high vigorous jump/splash, chase or coordinated heavy movement. Not physical speed measurement.
rubric.comicPressure: Editorial unresolved nuisance: low no active problem or settled outcome; medium continuing but managed source/inconvenience; high immediate spill, blockage, multiplication or obstruction. Never danger, fear, fatigue or measured audience stress. Background water stays medium from recognition28 until cessation132, even during warm pauses.
rubric.attention: Editorial learning/discovery emphasis: low routine or uncomplicated play; medium noticing, intention or application; high comparing the task, testing the channel, asking about the source or testing/reversing the circle. Not measured child attention.

warmthBand.foregrounded: Family play, care, reunion or collaboration is the focal beat.
warmthBand.supporting: Friendly presence or help supports the main beat.
warmthBand.not-foregrounded: The task, individual discovery or nuisance is foregrounded; not a claim that the image feels cold.

rubric.waterState: Independent objective continuity track: routing water is not magical source cessation.

sequences.title: The morning task
sequences.summary: A familiar family morning gives the water errand a purpose.

sequences.title: The spring trip and home arrivals
sequences.summary: Empty-to-full buckets establish the work that the shortcut will replace; friendship and bird splashes supply a small early joke.

sequences.title: The shortcut works—at first
sequences.summary: Too little water prompts an idea, a spell and a sustained interval of delighted discovery.

sequences.title: The water will not stop
sequences.summary: Polite requests fail; the family peeks in and starts practical containment.

sequences.title: Papa's splash and the family bath
sequences.summary: Papa converts the inconvenience into shared play; the jump has anticipation, impact and a reaction before quiet underwater discovery.

sequences.title: Tea, then the practical question
sequences.summary: A shared pause is interrupted by Mama noticing the continuing overflow; Papa proposes help and they protect the bedroom.

sequences.title: Beaver's plan and prototype
sequences.summary: Travel, explanation, a downhill experiment and collaborative preparation make the channel solution legible.

sequences.title: A road for the water
sequences.summary: The family installs the tested design, succeeds in routing the spill and settles down; the source audibly remains active.

sequences.title: Day two: flowers instead of a stop
sequences.summary: Domestic life adjusts to the gutter; a stopping spell produces flowers, then a clog, then a practical clearing response.

sequences.title: Breakfast, intention and a talking duck
sequences.summary: Thinking over breakfast leads to a flower-removal spell, an unexpected voice and time for several listening reactions.

sequences.title: The duck's ride becomes twelve ducks
sequences.summary: The channel becomes a ride. A request for quiet multiplies the noise, and the family gives the ducks a pool.

sequences.title: A plant that will not fit
sequences.summary: Making room for ducks grows a plant; corner relocation works briefly, renewed growth motivates a second move outside.

sequences.title: Petals become floating bubbles
sequences.summary: A cleanup intention produces floating bubbles; a missed catch leads to a cooperative towel rescue and a final splat.

sequences.title: Look, test, reverse
sequences.summary: The method changes from another command to observing the source, testing a small reversal, noticing its limit and completing it.

sequences.title: Cleanup and a home for the ducks
sequences.summary: Removing the now-unneeded gutter proves closure; the family brings the surviving ducks to a real lake.

en: A stripe of sunshine tickled PinPin’s nose. Beside him, Mama opened her eyes.
ru: Солнечный лучик пощекотал Пин-Пину нос. Рядом Мама открыла глаза.

evidence.caption: A stripe of sunshine tickled PinPin’s nose. Beside him, Mama opened her eyes.

en: Mama stirred the porridge. Papa bounced little PomPom on his knee.
ru: Мама помешивала кашу. Папа покачивал маленького Пом-Пома на коленях.

evidence.caption: Mama stirred the porridge. Papa bounced little PomPom on his knee.

en: PinPin watched the warm little clouds above Mama’s pot. Mama smiled down at him.
ru: Пин-Пин смотрел на тёплые облачка над Маминой кастрюлькой. Мама улыбнулась ему.

evidence.caption: PinPin watched the warm little clouds above Mama’s pot. Mama smiled down at him.

en: “Please bring some water for the bath,” said Mama. PinPin picked up the two little buckets.
ru: «Принеси, пожалуйста, воды для ванны», — сказала мама. Пин-Пин взял два маленьких ведёрка.

evidence.caption: “Please bring some water for the bath,” said Mama. PinPin picked up the two little buckets.

en: Out through the front door he went. The empty buckets swung beside his knees.
ru: Он вышел через входную дверь. Пустые ведёрки покачивались у его коленок.

evidence.caption: Out through the front door he went. The empty buckets swung beside his knees.
evidence.visual: Exterior doorway: Mama watches PinPin leave with two wooden buckets.

en: “Good morning, PinPin!” called his rabbit friend. “Where are you going?”
ru: «Доброе утро, Пин-Пин! — позвал его друг Кролик. — Ты куда?»

evidence.caption: “Good morning, PinPin!” called his rabbit friend. “Where are you going?”

en: “To fetch water for our bath.” PinPin showed his empty bucket. “I’ll come with you,” said Rabbit.
ru: «За водой для нашей ванны». Пин-Пин показал пустое ведёрко. «Я с тобой», — сказал Кролик.

evidence.caption: “To fetch water for our bath.” PinPin showed his empty bucket. “I’ll come with you,” said Rabbit.

en: The spring splashed over the stones. “Hello, PinPin!” chirped two little birds.
ru: Родник журчал по камешкам. «Привет, Пин-Пин!» — защебетали две птички.

evidence.caption: The spring splashed over the stones. “Hello, PinPin!” chirped two little birds.

en: PinPin held the first bucket under the stream. Glug, glug, glug.
ru: Пин-Пин подставил первое ведёрко под струйку. Буль-буль-буль.

evidence.caption: PinPin held the first bucket under the stream. Glug, glug, glug.

en: The little bird shook its wet feathers all around PinPin. “My bath has started!”
ru: Птичка отряхнула мокрые пёрышки и обрызгала Пин-Пина. «Моё купание уже началось!»

evidence.caption: The little bird shook its wet feathers all around PinPin. “My bath has started!”
evidence.visual: PinPin, rabbit, wet bird and filled bucket share the spring setting.

en: Rabbit steadied the full bucket. PinPin filled the other one.
ru: Кролик придержал полное ведёрко. Пин-Пин наполнил второе.

evidence.caption: Rabbit steadied the full bucket. PinPin filled the other one.

en: “See you later!” called PinPin. This time the buckets swung very little.
ru: «До встречи!» — сказал Пин-Пин. Теперь ведёрки почти не качались.

evidence.caption: “See you later!” called PinPin. This time the buckets swung very little.

en: “Two buckets, Mama!” Mama held the door open. “The bath is waiting.”
ru: «Два ведёрка, мама!» Мама придержала дверь. «Ванна тебя ждёт».

evidence.caption: “Two buckets, Mama!” Mama held the door open. “The bath is waiting.”

en: Scooby dug a hole beside the path. Papa rescued a little plant.
ru: Скуби выкопал ямку у дорожки. Папа спас маленькое растение.

evidence.caption: Scooby dug a hole beside the path. Papa rescued a little plant.

en: “This way, Scooby!” said Papa. Off they went, side by side.
ru: «Сюда, Скуби!» — сказал Папа. И они пошли рядом друг с другом.

evidence.caption: “This way, Scooby!” said Papa. Off they went, side by side.

en: Papa pushed open the green door and looked back. “Come on, Scooby!”
ru: Папа открыл зелёную дверь и оглянулся. «Заходи, Скуби!»

evidence.caption: Papa pushed open the green door and looked back. “Come on, Scooby!”

en: PinPin carried the buckets carefully. A little splash landed on his toes.
ru: Пин-Пин осторожно понёс ведёрки. Немного воды плеснуло ему на лапки.

evidence.caption: PinPin carried the buckets carefully. A little splash landed on his toes.

en: He poured both buckets into the bath. The bottom was only just covered.
ru: Он вылил оба ведёрка в ванну. Вода едва покрыла дно.

evidence.caption: He poured both buckets into the bath. The bottom was only just covered.

en: PinPin peered into the clear water. His little face peered back.
ru: Пин-Пин заглянул в чистую воду. Его мордашка смотрела на него.

evidence.caption: PinPin peered into the clear water. His little face peered back.

en: He looked at the buckets, then at the big bath. “That will take lots of trips.”
ru: Он посмотрел на ведёрки, потом на большую ванну. — Это сколько же раз ходить!

evidence.caption: He looked at the buckets, then at the big bath. “That will take lots of trips.”
evidence.visual: Small PinPin and buckets beside the substantially larger wooden bath make the scale comparison visible.

en: PinPin’s eyes lit up. “I could make the water come here!”
ru: Глаза Пин-Пина загорелись. — А я могу сделать воду прямо здесь!

evidence.caption: PinPin’s eyes lit up. “I could make the water come here!”

en: “Round and round… just so!” PinPin traced a golden circle.
ru: «Круг за кругом… вот так!» Пин-Пин обвёл золотой круг.

evidence.caption: “Round and round… just so!” PinPin traced a golden circle.

en: Drip, drip—then a little stream! PinPin’s eyes opened wide.
ru: Кап, кап — и побежала струйка! Пин-Пин раскрыл глаза.

evidence.caption: Drip, drip—then a little stream! PinPin’s eyes opened wide.

en: He rested his paws on the rim. Round little ripples spread beneath them.
ru: Он положил лапки на край ванны. Внизу разбегались круглые волны.

evidence.caption: He rested his paws on the rim. Round little ripples spread beneath them.

en: PinPin listened to the little splashes. He liked this very much.
ru: Пин-Пин слушал тихий плеск. Как же ему это нравилось!

evidence.caption: PinPin listened to the little splashes. He liked this very much.

en: He drew little ripples with his paw. Round and round they went.
ru: Он провёл лапкой по воде. По воде разбежались круги.

evidence.caption: He drew little ripples with his paw. Round and round they went.

en: The water rose higher. Soon the bath was full.
ru: Вода поднималась всё выше. Скоро ванна наполнилась.

evidence.caption: The water rose higher. Soon the bath was full.

en: “That’s enough,” said PinPin. The water kept coming.
ru: — Хватит уже, — сказал Пин-Пин. А вода всё лилась.

evidence.caption: “That’s enough,” said PinPin. The water kept coming.

en: “Thank you. That’s enough!” A ribbon of water slipped over the edge.
ru: — Спасибо, уже хватит! — Тонкая струйка перелилась через край.

evidence.caption: “Thank you. That’s enough!” A ribbon of water slipped over the edge.
evidence.visual: Water visibly spills over the wooden tub rim while PinPin watches.

en: PinPin caught the water in a bucket. “Papa, it won’t stop!”
ru: Пин-Пин подставил ведёрко. «Папа, вода не останавливается!»

evidence.caption: PinPin caught the water in a bucket. “Papa, it won’t stop!”

en: Three faces peeked round the door. Papa looked over Mama, and PomPom looked out from her arms.
ru: Из-за двери выглянули три лица. Папа смотрел над Мамой, а Пом-Пом — из её рук.

evidence.caption: Three faces peeked round the door. Papa looked over Mama, and PomPom looked out from her arms.
evidence.visual: Three family faces peek around the doorway, stacked at different heights.

en: Papa followed the little stream with his eyes. Then the family came closer.
ru: Папа проследил взглядом за ручейком. Потом семья подошла ближе.

evidence.caption: Papa followed the little stream with his eyes. Then the family came closer.

en: Papa looked at the stream, then at PinPin. He put the second bucket under the spill.
ru: Папа посмотрел на струйку, потом на Пин-Пина. Он подставил второе ведёрко.

evidence.caption: Papa looked at the stream, then at PinPin. He put the second bucket under the spill.

en: Mama put the towels up high. Papa felt the warm water with his paw.
ru: Мама убрала полотенца повыше. Папа потрогал лапкой тёплую воду.

evidence.caption: Mama put the towels up high. Papa felt the warm water with his paw.

en: “We are getting wet anyway,” said Papa. “Here I come!”
ru: «Мы и так уже мокрые, — сказал Папа. — Сейчас прыгну!»

evidence.caption: “We are getting wet anyway,” said Papa. “Here I come!”

en: Up went Papa—both feet in the air!
ru: Папа подпрыгнул — обе лапы в воздухе!

evidence.caption: Up went Papa—both feet in the air!

en: SPLASH! Water flew onto everybody.
ru: ПЛЮХ! Брызги полетели на всех.

evidence.caption: SPLASH! Water flew onto everybody.
evidence.visual: Papa lands in the bath amid a broad splash; the family is gathered around.

en: PinPin blinked the drops away. Then he laughed.
ru: Пин-Пин стряхнул капли с ресниц. И засмеялся.

evidence.caption: PinPin blinked the drops away. Then he laughed.

en: “Come here, little one,” said Mama. She climbed in with PomPom in her arms.
ru: «Иди ко мне, малыш», — сказала Мама. Она забралась в ванну с Пом-Помом на руках.

evidence.caption: “Come here, little one,” said Mama. She climbed in with PomPom in her arms.

en: “Me too!” said PinPin. Papa gave him a paw.
ru: «И я!» — сказал Пин-Пин. Папа протянул ему лапу.

evidence.caption: “Me too!” said PinPin. Papa gave him a paw.

en: Now they were all in the bath. PomPom watched the splashes from Mama’s arms.
ru: Теперь все были в ванне. Пом-Пом смотрел на брызги из Маминых объятий.

evidence.caption: Now they were all in the bath. PomPom watched the splashes from Mama’s arms.

en: PinPin dipped his face under the water. Bubbles tickled his cheeks.
ru: Пин-Пин опустил мордочку в воду. Пузырьки пощекотали ему щёки.

evidence.caption: PinPin dipped his face under the water. Bubbles tickled his cheeks.
evidence.visual: Underwater close-up foregrounds PinPin's face and bubbles.

en: Their faces wobbled in the ripples. PomPom waved from Mama’s arms.
ru: Лица отражались в волнах. Пом-Пом махал из Маминых объятий.

evidence.caption: Their faces wobbled in the ripples. PomPom waved from Mama’s arms.

en: Mama brought a little tray of tea. Papa held PomPom while she set it beside the bath.
ru: Мама принесла маленький поднос с чаем. Папа держал Пом-Пома, пока она ставила поднос рядом с ванной.

evidence.caption: Mama brought a little tray of tea. Papa held PomPom while she set it beside the bath.

en: The tea was warm. PinPin made one little ripple, and then another.
ru: Чай был тёплый. Пин-Пин пустил по воде одну маленькую волну, а потом ещё одну.

evidence.caption: The tea was warm. PinPin made one little ripple, and then another.
evidence.visual: Family shares the bath; Papa holds the infant while the grownups have tea.

en: Mama watched the water trickling over the rim. “And where shall all this water go?”
ru: Мама посмотрела на воду, переливавшуюся через край. «А куда мы денем всю эту воду?»

evidence.caption: Mama watched the water trickling over the rim. “And where shall all this water go?”

en: “Beaver and I could build a wooden channel,” said Papa. “All the way to the garden.”
ru: «Мы с Бобром можем построить деревянный желоб, — сказал Папа. — До самого сада».

evidence.caption: “Beaver and I could build a wooden channel,” said Papa. “All the way to the garden.”

en: Water was still spilling onto the floor. “Out we come,” said Mama.
ru: Вода всё ещё лилась на пол. «Пора вылезать», — сказала Мама.

evidence.caption: Water was still spilling onto the floor. “Out we come,” said Mama.

en: Mama shut the bedroom door. She put a rolled towel at the bottom.
ru: Мама закрыла дверь в спальню. Внизу она положила свёрнутое полотенце.

evidence.caption: Mama shut the bedroom door. She put a rolled towel at the bottom.

en: Papa packed bread and fruit. “Up you come!” He helped PinPin onto Scooby.
ru: Папа взял хлеб и фрукты. «Залезай!» Он помог Пин-Пину забраться на Скуби.

evidence.caption: Papa packed bread and fruit. “Up you come!” He helped PinPin onto Scooby.

en: Scooby trotted between the trees. PinPin watched the sun hop from leaf to leaf.
ru: Скуби бежал между деревьями. Пин-Пин смотрел, как солнечные зайчики прыгают с листочка на листочек.

evidence.caption: Scooby trotted between the trees. PinPin watched the sun hop from leaf to leaf.

en: “Good morning!” called PinPin. Beaver put down his tools and came to meet them.
ru: «Доброе утро!» — позвал Пин-Пин. Бобр отложил инструменты и вышел им навстречу.

evidence.caption: “Good morning!” called PinPin. Beaver put down his tools and came to meet them.

en: Over bread and fruit, PinPin told Beaver about the bath. “It keeps filling, even when nobody is splashing!”
ru: Они ели хлеб и фрукты, а Пин-Пин рассказывал Бобру про ванну. «Она всё наполняется, даже когда никто не плещется!»

evidence.caption: Over bread and fruit, PinPin told Beaver about the bath. “It keeps filling, even when nobody is splashing!”

en: Beaver drew a little path in the earth. “We’ll give the water a road of its own.”
ru: Бобр начертил на земле дорожку. «Сделаем для воды её собственную дорогу».

evidence.caption: Beaver drew a little path in the earth. “We’ll give the water a road of its own.”
evidence.visual: Beaver draws a route on the ground; Papa and PinPin attend nearby.

en: He joined two little wooden gutters. “This end goes a little lower.”
ru: Он соединил два маленьких деревянных желоба. «А этот конец опустим чуть ниже».

evidence.caption: He joined two little wooden gutters. “This end goes a little lower.”

en: PinPin tipped the little jug. The water ran down, from one piece into the next.
ru: Пин-Пин наклонил кувшинчик. Вода побежала вниз — из одного желоба в другой.

evidence.caption: PinPin tipped the little jug. The water ran down, from one piece into the next.
evidence.visual: A small raised wooden gutter demonstration visibly carries water into a basin.

en: Beaver shaped the wood. Papa checked the edges, and PinPin stacked the little supports.
ru: Бобр придавал дереву нужную форму. Папа проверял края, а Пин-Пин складывал маленькие подпорки.

evidence.caption: Beaver shaped the wood. Papa checked the edges, and PinPin stacked the little supports.

en: They tied the light bundles on Scooby’s sides. He stood very still until the last knot was done.
ru: Лёгкие связки закрепили по бокам у Скуби. Он стоял совсем неподвижно, пока не завязали последний узел.

evidence.caption: They tied the light bundles on Scooby’s sides. He stood very still until the last knot was done.

en: Mama met them at the door. Papa lifted down the wooden pieces, and PinPin carried the little blocks.
ru: Мама встретила их у двери. Папа снимал деревянные детали, а Пин-Пин нёс маленькие брусочки.

evidence.caption: Mama met them at the door. Papa lifted down the wooden pieces, and PinPin carried the little blocks.

en: Papa brought some short wooden gutters. PinPin made room for them.
ru: Папа принёс короткие деревянные желобки. Пин-Пин освободил для них место.

evidence.caption: Papa brought some short wooden gutters. PinPin made room for them.

en: Papa put a wide wooden mouth under the spill. The water splashed into it.
ru: Папа подставил под струйку широкий деревянный лоток. Вода заплескалась в нём.

evidence.caption: Papa put a wide wooden mouth under the spill. The water splashed into it.

en: They laid one end over the next. PinPin held it while Papa joined the pieces.
ru: Один конец положили поверх другого. Пин-Пин придерживал, а Папа соединял.

evidence.caption: They laid one end over the next. PinPin held it while Papa joined the pieces.

en: Papa moved the little blocks underneath. Each piece rested a little lower.
ru: Папа передвинул подпорки снизу. Каждый желобок оказался чуть ниже предыдущего.

evidence.caption: Papa moved the little blocks underneath. Each piece rested a little lower.
evidence.visual: Papa and PinPin adjust a supported channel at floor level beside the tub.

en: The water ran along their wooden path. It passed the table without wetting the legs.
ru: Вода побежала по деревянной дорожке. Мимо стола — не замочив ножек.

evidence.caption: The water ran along their wooden path. It passed the table without wetting the legs.

en: Out it went through the open door. PinPin watched it reach the garden.
ru: Через открытую дверь вода побежала наружу. Пин-Пин смотрел, как она течёт в сад.

evidence.caption: Out it went through the open door. PinPin watched it reach the garden.
evidence.visual: The channel visibly carries water through the exterior doorway toward the garden.

en: Mama wiped the puddles. PinPin squeezed out a cloth.
ru: Мама вытерла лужицы. Пин-Пин отжал тряпочку.

evidence.caption: Mama wiped the puddles. PinPin squeezed out a cloth.

en: The family tucked in together. Beyond the door, the water whispered shhh.
ru: Вся семья устроилась под одеялом. За дверью вода шептала: ш-ш-ш.

evidence.caption: The family tucked in together. Beyond the door, the water whispered shhh.

en: Morning again! PinPin stretched both paws.
ru: Снова утро! Пин-Пин потянулся обеими лапками.

evidence.caption: Morning again! PinPin stretched both paws.

en: Papa stepped over the gutter with breakfast. PinPin brought the spoons.
ru: Папа перешагнул через желоб с завтраком. Пин-Пин принёс ложки.

evidence.caption: Papa stepped over the gutter with breakfast. PinPin brought the spoons.

en: A little drip escaped. Papa pushed the two pieces together.
ru: Маленькая капля убежала. Папа сдвинул два желобка.

evidence.caption: A little drip escaped. Papa pushed the two pieces together.

en: PinPin squeezed the cloth. A whole shower fell into the bucket!
ru: Пин-Пин выжал тряпку. В ведро полился целый дождик!

evidence.caption: PinPin squeezed the cloth. A whole shower fell into the bucket!

en: “Round and round… just so! Water, stop.”
ru: «Круг за кругом… вот так! Вода, остановись».

evidence.caption: “Round and round… just so! Water, stop.”

en: Flowers opened on the water. The stream kept running.
ru: На воде раскрылись цветы. А ручеёк всё бежал.

evidence.caption: Flowers opened on the water. The stream kept running.
evidence.visual: Golden circle and flowers share the water surface; PinPin watches from the rim.

en: Mama moved a flower to see her toes. Another opened in its place.
ru: Мама отодвинула цветок, чтобы увидеть пальцы. На его месте раскрылся другой.

evidence.caption: Mama moved a flower to see her toes. Another opened in its place.

en: The flowers crowded into the gutter. “Not that way!” said PinPin.
ru: Цветы столпились в желобе. «Не туда!» — сказал Пин-Пин.

evidence.caption: The flowers crowded into the gutter. “Not that way!” said PinPin.
evidence.visual: Close-up of flower heads lodged at a channel join; water continues along the trough.

en: Papa lifted PomPom to see. Mama and PinPin came to look at the crowded gutter.
ru: Папа приподнял Пом-Пома, чтобы тот увидел. Мама и Пин-Пин подошли посмотреть на забитый желоб.

evidence.caption: Papa lifted PomPom to see. Mama and PinPin came to look at the crowded gutter.

en: Papa scooped them out. Mama held a big bowl.
ru: Папа вынимал цветы. Мама держала большую миску.

evidence.caption: Papa scooped them out. Mama held a big bowl.

causalChain.title: Water that will not stop
causalChain.persistentConsequence: Source continues until scene132; delight at23 becomes a problem28–30.

causalChain.title: A road for the water
causalChain.persistentConsequence: Spill is routed, not stopped. The channel later carries flowers and ducks.

causalChain.title: A stopping spell makes flowers
causalChain.persistentConsequence: Flowers persist and obstruct the route; collecting them permits flow but does not switch it off.

causalChain.title: Removing flowers gives the duck a voice
causalChain.persistentConsequence: The duck enjoys the current and asks for more; its voice survives the ending.

causalChain.title: Quiet please becomes twelve
causalChain.persistentConsequence: Twelve ducks need space; flowers obstruct their tails. They remain twelve.

causalChain.title: Smaller please becomes larger
causalChain.persistentConsequence: A corner move makes room only briefly; continuing growth112 motivates the outdoor move. Petals remain116.

causalChain.title: Clearing petals produces floating bubbles
causalChain.persistentConsequence: The family moves bubbles outside and catches objects; the source still flows124.

causalChain.title: Observe and reverse the original circle
causalChain.persistentConsequence: Partial backward motion thins the stream; stopping too early brings it back. Complete reversal stops it.

causalChain.title: A permanent home for the ducks
causalChain.persistentConsequence: The original problem ends; the funny new characters remain.

findings.title: The family gets real jobs and real play
findings.text: Shared play, testing, construction, collection and carrying make this a family story rather than a sequence of solo spells.

findings.title: Reveals have reaction space
findings.text: Papa's jump and the duck's voice both allow anticipation, reveal and a held reaction. Multiplication is followed by counting and a visible procession.

findings.title: Practical successes never pretend the source stopped
findings.text: The whispering water and subsequent action keep the source active. Removing the channel only after132 gives closure a visible consequence.

findings.title: A long first act, with several different payoffs
findings.text: Day1 occupies67 of138 scenes. First magical outcome23 to next73 spans50 positions, but contains the splash, bath intimacy, tea, prototype and working channel. This is not49 empty frames; read-aloud pacing should vary between those mini-arcs.

findings.title: The prototype is repeated at full scale
findings.text: This can be satisfying learning-by-application; it is the clearest place to test whether explaining every join twice slows a familiar rereading. Observe a real read-through before proposing cuts.

findings.title: The giant plant is moved twice
findings.text: The renewed-growth line112 earns the second move. Without holding that causal line, the two moves might feel repetitive. No story edit is proposed here.

findings.title: The decisive change is a new method
findings.text: He asks about the source at102, but examines it at125:23 positions later. The intervening plant and bubble problems have causes. The final quiet sequence needs attention rather than more physical action.

findings.title: A repeated request changes meaning
findings.text: 'Enough' and 'more' oppose each other through water and duck requests; the final 'More room' in English / spaciousness in Russian gives the ducks a fitting ending. This is an intended textual comic pattern, not a measured audience laugh.

findings.title: Six complications, not the abandoned twelve
findings.text: Water, flowers, voice, twelve ducks, giant plant and bubbles are the six current magical outcomes. The removed cloud/rain/shoes/clothing paths belong to an older plan; do not score the final story against a twelve-failure quota.
